chapters.label: Live: the 2021 semi-final
chapters.text: The 2021 Futsal World Cup semi-final, in Kaunas. Kazakhstan play Portugal. Douglas is Kazakhstan’s fixo, the last defender. In extra time, he scores, and Kazakhstan lead two one!

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: Fixos defend, but Douglas can shoot from far out too. This is how he does it: the ball rolls to him, he steps in and strikes. Boom!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Head over the ball, standing foot beside it, laces through the middle, and follow through!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: hit through the middle of the ball for a straight, powerful shot!
